403K likes, 1,526 comments - vogueindia on December 22, 2024: "When Anupama Parameswaran was younger, she longed for the grace of Raja Ravi Varma’s muses, wishing, quietly, to carry it as her own. For our January-February cover, this dream is actualised as the actor is reimagined as Padmini, the lotus nymph, immortalised on Varma’s canvas. In conversation with the star, we explore the quiet details of a loud life.
